## Open findings

### High (3)

- `byok-active-state-not-indicated` — **ByokSection** — Active BYOK state is not explicitly indicated — inferred only from an inverse-labeled toggle
- `coding-credentials-wrong-fixture-stories` — **CodingCredentialsSection** — Both stories serve the wrong (`forge`) fixture — the real agent-provider form is never screenshotted, and the empty story misrepresents the shipped empty state — `client/stories/msw/settings-handlers-personal.ts:21`
- `tools-preset-active-state-invisible` — **ToolsSection** — Preset selector's active state is invisible at rest and its indicator is detached

### Med (22)

- `ai-output-raw-warning-not-associated` — **AiOutputSection** — Privacy-sensitive "Raw" warning is not associated with the control — `client/settings/sections/AiOutputSection.svelte:77`
- `ai-output-segment-label-contrast` — **AiOutputSection** — Unselected segment label falls below the contrast minimum — `client/shared/ui/SegmentedControl.svelte:56`
- `ai-output-toggle-no-feedback` — **AiOutputSection** — The toggle gives no in-flight feedback and reverts silently on failure
- `byok-load-error-raw-message` — **ByokSection** — Load-error state drops the primary control and shows the raw server message — `client/settings/sections/ByokSection.svelte:143`
- `byok-redundant-double-label` — **ByokSection** — Redundant double label on every field — `client/settings/sections/ByokSection.svelte:178`
- `byok-status-not-announced` — **ByokSection** — Section status/error not announced to assistive tech
- `code-host-setup-hint-unbounded-measure` — **CodeHostSection** — The first-setup hint paragraph runs as one unbroken ~1230px line with no `max-width` — `CodeHostSection.svelte:280`
- `coding-credentials-no-focus-ring` — **CodingCredentialsSection** — Raw selects/combobox have no app focus ring — keyboard focus is inconsistent with the rest of the form — `CodingCredentialsSection.svelte:389`
- `coding-credentials-raw-select-inputs` — **CodingCredentialsSection** — Raw `<select>` / `<input list>` instead of the shared `Select` / `Input` primitives — `CodingCredentialsSection.svelte:289`
- `coding-credentials-select-sizing-off-scale` — **CodingCredentialsSection** — `.coding-select` sizing/typography is off the shared scale — `CodingCredentialsSection.svelte:389`
- `coding-credentials-selects-blend-into-card` — **CodingCredentialsSection** — Agent/provider/auth selects use the card background token, so they blend into their own field card — `CodingCredentialsSection.svelte:394`
- `group-provider-null-silently-preselected` — **GroupProviderSection** — "Not yet configured" is indistinguishable from "configured to the first option"
- `guest-mode-toggle-not-exposed-a11y` — **GuestModeSection** — Binary toggle state is not exposed to assistive tech
- `profile-clear-low-affordance` — **ProfileSection** — "Clear" destructive action looks like plain label text — `client/settings/components/ConfigFieldRow.svelte:138`
- `profile-empty-state-dead-end` — **ProfileSection** — Empty state dead-ends on the section every user lands on first — `client/settings/sections/ProfileSection.svelte:57`
- `profile-error-no-recovery` — **ProfileSection** — Error state is a raw message with no in-place recovery — `client/settings/sections/ProfileSection.svelte:53`
- `profile-save-clear-full-flash` — **ProfileSection** — Every save/clear flashes the whole section to "Loading…" — `client/settings/sections/ProfileSection.svelte:61`
- `task-provider-null-silently-preselected` — **TaskProviderSection** — "Not yet configured" is indistinguishable from "configured to the first option"
- `task-provider-raw-id-options` — **TaskProviderSection** — Task-instance options fall back to a raw internal id when no friendly name exists — `client/settings/sections/TaskProviderSection.svelte:132`
- `tools-bulk-actions-look-like-text` — **ToolsSection** — Bare "Ask all" / "Deny all" / "Allow all" row actions look like plain text, not buttons
- `tools-confirm-no-busy-state` — **ToolsSection** — Preset Apply/Clear confirm bar gives no in-flight feedback while the request is pending
- `tools-no-per-group-count` — **ToolsSection** — Populated/grouped rows are sparse — no per-domain or per-group tool count
